description: This PHP source file defines the ImportViewConfirm class responsible for handling the confirmation step of the import process in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM module. It manages file uploads, validation, CSV auto-detection, import mapping, and rendering the confirmation template along with associated JavaScript for frontend interactions.

classes.name: ImportViewConfirm
classes.description: A view handler class for the import confirmation step, managing file validation, configuration, and rendering of confirmation page.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to handle the display and processing of the import confirmation interface, including file handling, validation, and preparing data for the template.

methods.name: getDelimeterOptions
methods.description: Returns HTML options for selecting CSV delimiters.

methods.name: getEnclosureOptions
methods.description: Returns HTML options for selecting CSV field enclosures.

methods.name: overloadImportFileMapFromRequest
methods.description: Overrides import file mapping options with values from the request.

methods.name: shouldAutoDetectProperties
methods.description: Determines whether to auto-detect CSV properties based on import source.

methods.name: getImportMap
methods.description: Retrieves the import map configuration based on source or custom map id.

methods.name: setNumberFormatOptions
methods.description: Configures number formatting options such as thousand separator, decimal separator, and significant digits.

methods.name: setCurrencyOptions
methods.description: Prepares currency selection options and JavaScript for currency symbol updates.

methods.name: setDateTimeProperties
methods.description: Sets date, time, and timezone preferences for import locale.

methods.name: setImportFileCharacterSet
methods.description: Sets character encoding options for import files.

methods.name: getImportMappingJS
methods.description: Fetches available import mappings and returns their JS representation.

methods.name: getMaxColumnsInSampleSet
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of columns in a sample data set.

methods.name: getSampleSet
methods.description: Retrieves a sample set of rows from the import file for preview.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for frontend interactions in the import confirmation page.

methods.name: _showImportError
methods.description: Displays an error message template for import errors.
